notes: Random slot packets for the current grid record (also with the high byte set) or another, with the change flag clear or set; the object lookup (0x7489c) finds it or not; the slot values (0x84f60) come from a queue of doubles equal to the remembered one, +0.0, -0.0 or others (no NaNs); the shown value is frozen or not; both stubs log their narrowed arguments.
